title: PCSO donates mobility aids and medical items to Caloocan 2nd district

blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) donated wheelchairs, canes and nebulizers to the 2nd District of Caloocan, during a turnover ceremony held on October 6, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office. The assistance aims to address the mobility and healthcare needs of vulnerable sectors in the community. PCSO Executive Assistant VI Maria Katrina Nicole Contacto-Ventanilla
